mods.name: Cytra Area Scanner
mods.changelog:
- Enabled switch (Scanner tab): off stops the running scan, the overlay, the HUD and the scan hotkeys. Cytra Hub uses it for the on/off switch and profiles
- Mod icon (Cytra logo)

Needs Litematica 0.26.16+ and MaLiLib 0.27.20+.

mods.name: Cytra Bot Macros
mods.changelog:
- Client on/off switch: clientEnabled in config.json and /bm enable | /bm disable. Off: keys, hotkeys, quick add and starting macros from this client do nothing; running and server macros keep going. Cytra Hub uses it for the on/off switch and profiles
- Mod icon (Cytra logo)

mods.name: Cytra Carpet
mods.changelog: forceOpenContainers rule: chests, ender chests and shulker boxes open even when blocked. Right-click stairs and slabs with an empty hand to sit (/cytra sit rightclick). Phantom control: /cytra nophantoms with noPhantoms, noPhantomsDefault and noPhantomsBots (toggle/spawn/never) rules.

mods.name: Cytra Container
mods.changelog: Material list Contents button: switch Litematica's placement material list between Blocks, Containers (what goes inside the schematic's containers, shulker boxes counted with their contents, missing = not in the real container yet) and Both. The chosen list shows on the material list Info HUD.

mods.name: Cytra Creative
mods.changelog: Labs from the SMP: areas sent with Cytra Send become labs at the same coordinates, with a [Go to lab] button (now or on next join). Also: faster /cc perimeter.

mods.name: Cytra Hub
mods.changelog:
- Cytra button works with Essential: drawn on top of the title and pause screens with its own clicks, so menu mods can't hide it
- New setting: Menu button position (Auto, next to the buttons, or any corner); Auto uses the top-left corner when Essential is installed

mods.name: Cytra Ledger
mods.changelog: Server-only player action log (/ll). New: /ll wand gives the Ledger Wand - hold it and click blocks, containers or entities to see their history; right-click the air for what happened nearby.

mods.name: Cytra Link
mods.changelog: Bots may send larger messages once connected (up to 8 MB), so areas sent to labs travel fast.

mods.name: Cytra Mass Craft
mods.changelog: No dump containers: results are now crafted and dropped in one click, no pause before they drop.

mods.name: Cytra Send
mods.changelog: First release: the SMP side of Cytra Creative labs. Select an area (/cc send wand, or pos1/pos2) and run /cc send <name>; the bridge bot carries it to the CMP, where it becomes a lab with a [Go to lab] button. Up to 1024x1024, every height, unloaded chunks too.

mods.name: Cytra Shulker View
mods.changelog: Fix: labels on placed shulkers now show with Optimized Block Entities (they only flashed while opening).

mods.name: Cytra Waypoints
mods.changelog: Renamed to Cytra Waypoints (was SharedWaypoints). Same mod: waypoints, settings, permissions, /cway and Xaero's Shared set all carry over. New jar name cytra-waypoints-2.7.0.jar; the Hub swaps the old jar for you.

mods.name: Cytra-Syncmatica
mods.changelog:
- Chunk Claims screen: drag to claim chunks with a description, or release them
- Warning when a schematic is placed in someone else's claimed area
- Previews can be drawn from other angles
- Previews of .schem and .nbt files

mods.name: CytraBackups
mods.changelog: Restore preview: /cbackup preview <id> radius <0-7> (or chunks <dim> <x1> <z1> <x2> <z2>) turns an area of a backup into a Litematica schematic in place. With Cytra Syncmatica on the server it's shared right away; otherwise saved under previews/. /cbackup preview clear removes shared previews.

mods.name: CytraTrades
mods.changelog: Trade hall sweep no longer turns your camera and reaches every villager the server allows (walled-off ones too).

mods.name: StickyToggle
mods.changelog: Fixed: your toggles no longer reset back to ON every time you join a world or restart the game.
